## Appendix A: sample pool appendix for make_study tests

Each entry shows the question and choices verbatim, then the correct answer with a one-line why.

> **T1A01** Which agency regulates the amateur service in the United States?
> A. The FCC
> B. The ITU
> C. The Department of Defense
> D. The United Nations
> **Answer: A** — the FCC is the US regulator — taught in chapter 8.

Published ID line: `T1A01 (A) [97.1]`

> **T1A02** What is the purpose of the amateur service?
> A. Advancing skills in the technical and communication phases of the radio art
> B. Broadcasting music to the general public
> C. Providing commercial message traffic
> D. Coordinating military communications
> **Answer: A** — advancing skills is the service's stated purpose — taught in chapter 8.

Published ID line: `T1A02 (A) [97.1]`

> **T1B01** When must an amateur station transmit its call sign?
> A. Every 5 minutes during a contact
> B. At least every 10 minutes during and at the end of a contact
> C. Once per hour while operating
> D. Only at the beginning of a contact
> **Answer: B** — identification is required every ten minutes and at sign-off — taught in chapter 8.

Published ID line: `T1B01 (B) [97.119(a)]`

> **T2A01** What is a repeater?
> A. A station that retransmits your signal on a different frequency
> B. A radio that only receives weather broadcasts
> C. An antenna with more than one element
> D. A type of battery charger
> **Answer: A** — a repeater retransmits on a paired frequency — taught in chapter 6.

Published ID line: `T2A01 (A) [97.205]`

> **T5A01** What is the unit of electrical current?
> A. Volt
> B. Ampere
> C. Ohm
> D. Watt
> **Answer: B** — current is measured in amperes — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `T5A01 (B)`

> **T6C02** What is component 1 in figure T-1?
> A. Resistor
> B. Transistor
> C. Battery
> D. Connector
> **Answer: A** — component 1 is the base-current-limiting resistor — taught in chapter 1.

Published ID line: `T6C02 (A)`
